v. 0.0.1

**Update: First Complete and Playable Version 🎉**  

This is the first fully playable version of the game! While it's still full of bugs, it works and serves as a solid foundation for future iterations. Here's what you need to know about this version:  

- **Comment-Heavy Code:**  
  This version includes detailed comments to document every function and process. These were added to ensure I fully understood the logic and mechanics behind each part of the code.  

- **Teachable Foundation:**  
  This is the most teachable version of the project. It's designed to serve as a reference point as I streamline and refactor the code in future updates.  

- **Planned Updates:**  
  - I'll be revisiting `main.py` to optimize and refine the codebase.  
  - Future iterations will strip unnecessary comments to create a cleaner, more professional look that aligns with senior development standards.  

This marks an exciting milestone in the project, and I'm looking forward to improving and iterating on this foundation. Feedback and suggestions are always welcome!
